Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is said to be one of the three major luxury watch brands in the world. Among them, "Chronometer Royale" was registered as a trademark in 1907, and was a high-class line at the time when coercialization began the following year. As the name "ROYAL" suggests, it was mainly made for wealthy people in South America. This Chronometer Royale is a model created in 1998 as a limited edition in Japan to coemorate the 90th anniversary. The dial has a diamond at the 12 o'clock position. The white gold model is said to be produced in only 80 pieces. There are some small scratches, but it is in a beautiful state. We perform precision adjustment and exterior finishing.
